programmes.title: Kill For You
programmes.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programmes.title: Vanity Flaw
programmes.desc: Mallory is a young ambitious woman with dreams of becoming a successful dance choreographer in the industry. Being a risk taker, Mallory decides to dance at a strip club for one night after losing a dare, only to be captured by an obsessive man with a fetish for strippers and violence.

programmes.title: What Momma Says
programmes.desc: Nearly thirty, Paul Thomas, is still living with his mom. When Paul cannot pay his half of the rent, she kicks him out, forcing Paul to sink or swim when it comes to taking care of himself.

programmes.title: Heart of a Woman
programmes.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programmes.title: Her Best Revenge
programmes.desc: After a tragic death, five fraternity bother reunite at a vacation home, while the shadow of a death from their past lingers over them. A mysterious figure begins to send them threatening messages. Their secrets and loyalties are put to the test and they must uncover the truth about what happened that night five years ago.

programmes.title: Born Again Baddie
programmes.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programmes.title: I Hate I Love You
programmes.desc: Jacinda and Bradley Wright are Managing Partners of a media company. Over the past year, they have enjoyed unprecedented success, but it comes with a price. From betrayal to illegal activity, both love and business are being destroyed by motives that cause everyone to have an agenda and everyone to have something to gain or lose. The old saying “Keep your Friends close and your enemies closer” are the truest words one can ever speak.

programmes.title: The Drive
programmes.desc: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped, and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. With each mile, the certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock and resolve, as the threat to his daughter’s life grows more personal and more urgent.

programmes.title: Reality TV Murders
programmes.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programmes.title: Gimme the Loot
programmes.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programmes.title: If I Can't Have You
programmes.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programmes.title: Baddies Revenge
programmes.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programmes.title: Receipts
programmes.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programmes.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programmes.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programmes.title: Dangerous Affair
programmes.desc: Erika and Ryan are a happily married couple living in a high rise Apartment in Atlanta, Ga. everything is going great until Erika meets a handsome, mysterious man in her building and they start having an affair. Once Ryan finds out about the affair Erika ends it. But the mystery man has other plans. Will the married couple survive the Dangerous Affair?

programmes.title: Deadly Housewife
programmes.desc: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn’t get what she wants.

programmes.title: Covered Silence
programmes.desc: Looking for help from a lifetime of trauma, Lala checks in at a mental hospital. There, she meets Niani, and the two form an unbreakable bond of friendship. Once released, Niani learns she is pregnant, and is fearful that her mental illness, and medications will affect the baby. Lala takes it upon herself to protect Niani at all costs. All that changes when Lala's own mental health is jeopardized, when her estranged mother returns in her life.

programmes.title: Fall Semester
programmes.desc: Kid Kypree is a college student with dreams and ambitions of becoming the next great stand-up comic. One night he gets invited to a party hosted by his old friend Bo that thrusts him into a whirlwind of opportunities and challenges that will test his friendships, resolve, and his sense of humor. He will soon discover that success comes with its own set of comedic twists and turns!

programmes.title: Dues Paid
programmes.desc: Ava and Jessica are friends who cross paths with a drug dealer who offers them a job to help him legitimize his business after being under investigation. They start to cooperate with him by deterring the police during a murder investigation at the motel that Jessica works at. Lies and secrets are exchanged, and a world of gang related chaos begins to divide a once solid friendship.

programmes.title: Grimy Situation
programmes.desc: After being arrested at a young age during a drug deal gone wrong and spending part of her youth in prison for the attempted murder of Agent Harris, the now-paroled 30-year-old Camille Sanders has to find a way to make money without turning back to a life of crime and violating her parole. Struggling to survive with no source of income coming in, Camille's forced to live a double life to make ends meet while convincing her Parole Officer she's been

programmes.title: In This House
programmes.desc: Claudia is a medical student focused on building a perfect life with her live-in boyfriend Dr. Jayson. Her grandfather’s death forces her to go back to her hometown to face her estranged family and her past. Once she arrives, she uncovers sinister secrets and will stop at nothing to break the generational curse stemming from her family’s history.

programmes.title: Kingsmen
programmes.desc: Follows the story of the King family, a known crime syndicate in Dallas. When the beloved patriarch is killed, they fall under the wrath of a rival crime family, as well as local law enforcement. The four eldest brothers will do everything they can to protect their family.

programmes.title: The Loyalty Test
programmes.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programmes.title: The Groomsman
programmes.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programmes.title: It's Complicated AF
programmes.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programmes.title: Deadly Surrogate
programmes.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programmes.title: Crash Out
programmes.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programmes.title: The Other Sister
programmes.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programmes.title: Troubled Mystic
programmes.desc: Tracie is a single mother who meets Corey Daniels, the calculated and “perfect guy” looking for his next perfect family to manipulate by any means necessary.

programmes.title: Demon Time
programmes.desc: William is going through a tumultuous time in his life following the death of his father, and the break up of his girlfriend. As he begins to put his life back together, he discovers his father left behind a substantial debt that could cost him his life. William must face is past, and discover not only his truth, but his father’s as well.

programmes.title: Wish

programmes.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Stone Age Secrets"
programmes.desc: Even before the start of recorded history, ancient engineers across the World were erecting giant monuments. What was their purpose?

programmes.title: Megastructures: Gardens By The Bay
programmes.desc: Discover the making of Singapore’s Gardens by the Bay, where groundbreaking engineering created a spectacular urban oasis unlike any other.

programmes.title: Singapore's Field Of Dreams
programmes.desc: Follow the construction of Singapore’s billion-dollar sports hub, featuring a 55,000-seat stadium with a groundbreaking retractable domed roof.

programmes.title: The Ship Sinkers
programmes.desc: What fate awaits ships that were once proud vessels at bay, but have now turned into floating junkyards? While one option is to cut them up for scrap, another alternative is to use them to bolster marine biodiversity by turning them into artificial reefs. The old naval ships are sunk to an underwater resting place by ship sinkers.

programmes.title: Bright Now S1 - "Veggie Power"
programmes.desc: Doctors, chefs, and nutririonists show us how going green with fresh ingredients and flavors in our daily meals will improve out health.

programmes.title: Earthrise S1 - "Water"
programmes.desc: In India's Ladakh, rising temperatures are leading to glacial melt and water shortages in the mountains of the Himalayas. The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan is also sturggling as it experiences severe drought.

programmes.title: Earthrise S1 - "Air: Changing the Atmosphere"
programmes.desc: Every year seven million people die from air pollution. It's the world's biggest environmental killer.

programmes.title: Earthrise S1 - "Food"
programmes.desc: In South Africa and Nepal, earthrise looks at food production solutions being developed to help with adjusting to new conditions.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Tank"
programmes.desc: Stacey battles to save a severely injured hunting dog, Millie the calf has been mauled by a dog and the Mark and Stacey work together to change the gender of a cat.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "UFO"
programmes.desc: Meg the Labrador has swallowed a UFO, Chocolate the horse is suffering from asthma and Mark and Stacey compete in a chilli eating challenge.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Boss"
programmes.desc: Boss the dog has a nasty injury from a possum trap, the fire brigade are called to save a cat stuck up a tree and Mark and Stacey compete in a fireman’s challenge.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Darting"
programmes.desc: Stacey discovers Marama the poodle has breast cancer, Mark tries to save a herd of pregnant cows from miscarrying and the Vet North team dart calves amongst the dinosaurs.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Molly"
programmes.desc: Molly the dog is paralysed in a hit and run accident, Mark is having a busy day with pigs, goats, horses and a mauled cow and Stacey treats a tortoise with a sore leg.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Bear"
programmes.desc: Bear the Labrador has come into see Stacey again for a sore knee. Stacey travels up to Auckland to assist Mark with a calf that’s stuck in the birth cannel.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Cuban"
programmes.desc: Bear the labrador has a sore leg, which turns into a really expensive problem and Mark travels down to Rotorua to help Stacey with a busy day on the farm.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Sushi"
programmes.desc: Mark tries to save a girl’s pet lamb, Stacey treats Max who has bad arthritis and both Mark and Stacey volunteer for the day at SPCA.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Robbie"
programmes.desc: Howdie and Dawn are working dogs and their owner wants them to mate, but neither are interested so Stacey intervenes, Mark treats a horse with a very sore leg and Stacey operates on sushi the cat who has skin cancer.

programmes.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Willow"
programmes.desc: Willow’s leg is lame and Stacey decides to amputate, Jack the Jack Russel has been kicked out of doggy school and Stacey tries to help and Mark changes Shadow the cat from a male into a female.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sight"
programmes.desc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. People with good vision are sometimes called "eagle eyed", but eagles can see a fish from many dozen metres away.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Hearing"
programmes.desc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Touch"
programmes.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Taste and Smell"
programmes.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Superhuman Senses"
programmes.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programmes.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sense of Timing"
programmes.desc: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Underwater"
programmes.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programmes.desc: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground…

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Night"
programmes.desc: We find out about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive. Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason. You need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"
programmes.desc: We find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground. And find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "Communication"
programmes.desc: Animals use communication to attract mates,warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey. And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others.

programmes.title: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"
programmes.desc: In this last episode of Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do.

programmes.title: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Concrete to Clay"

programmes.title: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Wood to Bamboo"

programmes.title: Miracle Materials S1 - "Living Bridges And Fiber Constructions"
programmes.desc: Hybrid architecture integrates living trees and resource-efficient fiber designs to cool urban centers and transform modern building.

programmes.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programmes.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Baklava/Gyroplane/Ukulele"
programmes.desc: How do they make baklava, the favourite sweet of the Ottomans? How do they fly a gyroplane, James Bond’s vehicle of choice? How do they craft a ukulele, the Hawaiian instrument played by Elvis? How do they build a supercat, the world’s fastest ferry?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Longboards/Lemonade/Forklifts"
programmes.desc: How do they carve longboards, the skateboard’s bigger, faster brother? How do they turn tonnes of lemons into millions of bottles of lemons? How do they build industry’s versatile heavy lifter, the forklift truck?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Coffee/Bricks/Lavalamps/Diamonds"
programmes.desc: How do they roast the coffee that wakes up Italy? How do they bake the bricks that build America? How do they heat the oil that fills lava lamps? How do they blast diamonds from a frozen volcano?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Cameras/Big Airbags/ Jelly Beans"
programmes.desc: How do they take the world’s sharpest photos? How do they stitch an airbag that can catch a falling car? How do they make billions of perfect jelly beans?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Caravans/Tuning Forks/Ice Resurfacer/Festival of Lights"
programmes.desc: How do they build a caravan that’s tougher than an SUV? How do they forge tuning forks to provide musicians with perfect pitch? How do they resurface an ice rink in minutes? How do they put on the world’s biggest festival of lights?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Vinyl Records/Bumper Cars/Tiger Balm"
programmes.desc: How do they make the world’s grooviest music, the vinyl LP? How do they build the world’s most crashed car, the dodgem? How do they create one of the world’s oldest pain remedies, tiger balm?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Alcohol Free Beer/Tomcars/Escalators/Lie Detectors"
programmes.desc: How do they brew a beer that won’t make you drunk? How do they build a car that flies over rocks and boulders? How do they bolt together an escalator that will carry millions every year? How do they bust criminals with a lie detector?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Axes/Messenger Bags/Fast Rescue Boats"
programmes.desc: How do they forge one of the greatest inventions of all time, the axe? How do they cut, sew, stitch and glue together a courier’s messenger bag? How do they build the world’s fastest lifeboats?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Wensleydale Cheese/Paintbrushes/Eucalyptus Oil/Plastic Wrap"
programmes.desc: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programmes.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Surviving Space"
programmes.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits NASA’s Swamp Works, which tests space suits and machines for Mars-like conditions.

programmes.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Engineering Space"
programmes.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits four types of engineers who are on the cutting edge of aerospace technology.

programmes.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Satellite’s Eye View"

programmes.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "The Art of Space"
programmes.desc: Four artists display their unique methods of illustrating the mysterious frontier of outer space. Host, Emily Calandrelli tries spray painting as well.

programmes.title: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programmes.desc: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

programmes.title: The Aviators S2 - "Dream flight of a lifetime"
programmes.desc: Twenty pilots attend a T33 Silverstar ground school but only one will win a chance to actually fly it. We visit the Joe Nall event, the “Oshkosh” of RC flying, and Raeleen goes flying with rock stars of the air show circuit, the Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programmes.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft ownership"
programmes.desc: Kurtis explores the varied costs and entry points of flying for everyone from the weekend warrior to the rich and famous. When your driveway is a runway, life is good… and as airparks go, this place is Heavenly! Are two engines really better than one?

programmes.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft engines"
programmes.desc: Kurtis learns about aircraft power plants from Penn Yan Aero’s Bill Middlebrook, whose family has a long and rich history in American aviation. Anthony shows that buying The Aviators’ new 210 can be just as simple as buying a used car. And accessorizing it can be just as fun. Raeleen celebrates women in aviation at the most female friendly airport in the world.

programmes.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Underworld"
programmes.desc: Terry and Larry are going to test a famous scene from Underworld with Kate Beckensale. Terry will attempt to shoot a circle around himself in the floor and fall through to save himself from the pack of werewolves.

programmes.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "A Pirates Life for Terry"
programmes.desc: Terry and Larry go on a swashbuckling adventure when they test two scenes from the 1920’s film, The Black Pirate starring Douglas Fairbanks, Senior. Terry will see if he can knock down a ships mast with a canon, and then test gravity as he slides down a sail with only a knife.

programmes.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Terry Loves 70's Cop Shows"
programmes.desc: Terry travels back in time to the 70’s where he gets to relive his childhood dreams of becoming a 70’s TV cop. Larry helps Terry test several scenarios, including hiding behind a car door for cover, and if you can really shoot a gas tank from a car to make it explode.

programmes.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Breaking Terry Badly"
programmes.desc: Terry falls victim to Walter White in Breaking Bad, and Terry and Larry test 3 separate scenes from this iconic series, 2 of which need the help of Special Effects expert Andre Ellingson, including lighting a gas tank on fire and chemically burning through a steal door.

programmes.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Helping Hands"
programmes.desc: In this episode, we dive with dozens of bull sharks in Fiji. We then head to South Florida to plant native mangroves in an area of need. The journey ends with a trip to Maui.

programmes.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Formations"
programmes.desc: In this episode, Cousteau explores some of our planets most incredible natural formations.

programmes.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Sports & The Environment"
programmes.desc: In this episode, we travel to the intersection of sports and our environment.

programmes.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Student Explorer"
programmes.desc: In this episode, we reveal the winner of our second ever #StudentExplorer Contest.

programmes.title: Power & S2 - "Dennis Hong"
programmes.desc: Dennis Hong is the director of Robotics Mechanics Laboratory at UCLA and has invented numerous new robots earning the nickname the Leonardo da Vinci of Robots.

programmes.title: Power & S2 - "Don Shaw"
programmes.desc: Former NASA consultant Don Shaw has a unique set of patents on a space vehicle and several on advanced aircraft; vehicles that can drive, fly and hover.

programmes.title: Power & S2 - "Lucas Toledo"

programmes.title: Power & S2 - "Tabb Firchau"

programmes.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Q’s and A’s"
programmes.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Where’s the hottest place on earth? Where’s the coldest place? Is it true that a jellyfish has neither a heart nor brain? And what exactly is a Supernova?

programmes.title: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Wonder of Bridges"
programmes.desc: Pre-industrial societies around the world construct early bridges, reflecting evolving technologies and expanding human exploration.

programmes.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Modern Day Killer Asteroid"
programmes.desc: 66 million years ago, an asteroid slammed into Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula, causing a dinosaur mass extinction. With over 700,000 asteroids in space, what's in store for humanity and our planet if it happens again?

programmes.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Fixing A Broken Heart"
programmes.desc: Heart disease is the number one cause of death worldwide, but there are researchers frantically working to change that.

programmes.title: Breakthrough S1 - "T-Rex Timeline"
programmes.desc: The Tyrannosaurus Rex is known as the king of the dinosaurs, but how did its reigh begin? Meet Moros Intrepidus, a 180 lb., deer-sized ancestor to the T-Rex.

programmes.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Resurrecting Tasmanian Tigers"
programmes.desc: Wiped off the face of the Earth by humans nearly a century ago, geneticists are now working on ressurecting the enigmatic Tasmanian Tiger.

programmes.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "George Aldrich"
programmes.desc: Thom meets a man with a superhuman sense of smell; George Aldrich is Nasa’s Chief Sniffer; employed to detect problems before they become a hazard in space.

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Kenya"
programmes.desc: Mt.Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker:High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "By Camel to Timbuktu"
programmes.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Indian Monsoon"
programmes.desc: In June of next year we plan to intercept the Monsoon as it hits southern India and makes its way north along the western shore past Goa and Mumbai up to Delhi.This most famous of torrential rainy seasons drops as much as 40 feet of water.

programmes.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Java - Land of Fire"
programmes.desc: The most notorious volcanic explosion in history came from the small island of Krakatoa, off the coast of Java. The tiny island was pulverized and the giant explosion was felt half way around the world. Java is at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programmes.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Tank"
programmes.desc: Hand powered tank, is that possible? Leonardo Da Vinci thought so. Today we will test this theory.

programmes.episode: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection

programmes.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R.  The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna
programmes.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

programmes.title: AmeriCarna

programmes.title: AmeriCarna
programmes.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna
programmes.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programmes.title: AmeriCarna
